text: dsh-chat-local 是面向 DSH Web 的本地多 Agent 群聊插件。它在侧栏提供群聊工作区，并连接真实 DSH 会话。成员可按议题讨论、分派协作请求、维护工作台账并验收成果，也能管理个人身份、人格和亲历记忆。适合需要多个 Agent 分工协作的团队；需要兼容版本的 DSH，数据默认存于本机。

dsh-chat-local adds a group workspace to DSH Web, connecting real sessions for topic discussions, routed requests, task tracking, and review. Agents keep personal identities, personas, and experience-based memories. It suits teams coordinating agents and stores data locally.
dsh-chat-local 的功能「群聊工作区」：在 DSH Web 侧栏打开群聊，创建群组和议题对话，并管理参与成员及会话配置。
dsh-chat-local 的功能「协作台账」：Agent 可登记任务、进展、提交和评审，让团队查看责任分配及交付状态。
dsh-chat-local 的功能「个人记忆」：Agent 可查询基于本人已读、收到或产出材料的记忆，并维护自身身份与人格信息。
想让几个 DSH Agent 在一个群聊里按不同议题协作。
我需要把工作分给不同的 Agent，并追踪交付和验收状态。
怎样让 Agent 在不同会话间保留自己的经历和人格设定？
希望每个 Agent 通过真实 DSH 会话参与群组讨论。
想为团队成员建立独立的讨论空间和共享工作记录。
能不能让 Agent 明确接手任务并提交结果供别人验收？
I want several DSH agents to collaborate in topic-based group chats.
How can I track assignments and review deliverables across agents?

dsh-chat-local README · dsh-chat-local：**中文** · [English](README.en.md)

讓多個 Agent 在 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 裡討論、分工與交付，並各自保留持續的身分、人格設定和親歷記憶。

你可以組成一支團隊，為不同議題開新對話，讓成員互相點名、提交成果、要求驗收。同一位 Agent 換了對話或執行會話，仍可查詢自己真正看過的材料；其他成員的私人經歷不會因此變成共同記憶。

dsh-chat-local README · 能做什麼：| 功能 | 實際用途 |
| --- | --- |
| 團隊與對話 | 重用成員和預設配置，每個議題保留獨立的訊息、工作台帳與權限。 |
| Agent 互動 | 新對話按工作責任分流；通知不喚醒全員，更正與異議保留處置義務。舊對話保留原策略。 |
| 工作與成果 | 契約固定責任、材料與驗收標準；保存可取回的成果版本，驗收綁定同一份提交。 |
| 人格 Markdown | 為每位 Agent 設定性格、溝通偏好與工作習慣，保存版本並處理編輯衝突。 |
| 個人長期記憶 | 從實際送達、讀取與本人輸出建立記憶，查詢時保留來源。 |
| 記憶與學習 | 按當前工作召回親歷材料；有來源的方法候選可採納、拒絕或退休，信念可記錄反證。 |
| 執行與權限 | 成員透過真實 DSH Session 工作，沿用宿主的模型、工具、沙箱與審批。 |

dsh-chat-local README · 1. 安裝：已驗證的 DSH 版本是 `0.1.7-rc.2`，載入範圍限定為 `>=0.1.7-rc.2 <0.1.8-0`。需要先安裝 [dsh-bridge](https://github.com/baixianger/dsh-bridge)，由它負責本機會話喚醒與投遞。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ALPSIYH/dsh-chat-local
```

安裝後重啟 `dsh web`，點選側欄的「群聊」。既有安裝升級前，先依[升級與備份](docs/operations.md)保留完整資料目錄。

dsh-chat-local README · 2. 設定 Agent：在「群聊 → Agent」建立或編輯成員。名稱、職務與模型屬於工作配置；「編輯 … 的人格」則描述這位 Agent 跨工作保持的偏好。

人格欄位最初是**未啟用的待填模板**。例如，你可以寫：

```md

dsh-chat-local README · 工作習慣：先提出一條可驗證的路徑，說明關鍵假設，再開始實作。
收到新證據時修正判斷，並說清楚哪個前提變了。

dsh-chat-local README · 溝通偏好：先給結論，區分已確認、推測和仍需查證的內容。
```

保存後的設定用於後續回合。人格不會自動改寫，也不會提高執行權限。

dsh-chat-local README · 3. 建群組、開對話：建立群組並選擇成員，再為一個議題開新對話。你可以沿用團隊預設，也可以只調整這次的參與者、工作目錄與權限。

未指定策略的新對話預設按工作責任分流；重用群組範本則沿用其策略。工作分流時，普通要求先交負責人，尚未分工時交協調者。輸入框可選「僅告知」「請處理」「更正」「異議」，並選擇收件人與工作。正文提及名字不會自動派工。工作概況分開顯示待處理、執行額度與驗收結果；舊對話保留舊策略，可在停止執行後切換。單純保存成員或團隊配置不會啟動模型。

完整操作見[使用指南](docs/guide.md)。

dsh-chat-local README · Agent 如何延續記憶：```text
持續的 Agent 身分
├── 人格：使用者維護的 PERSONA.md
├── 經歷：本人確實收到、讀取或產生的內容
├── 信念：有適用範圍、有效期與反證的可修訂解釋

群聊投遞提供有長度上限的記憶摘要，Agent 也能用 `chat_recall` 查詢更多。原生會話的自動注入另受 DSH 預設控制：`minimal` 會停用執行期上下文，因此不自動帶入人格與個人記憶。參與者面板會顯示最近一次提示組裝所觀察到的狀態；要啟用，請開啟原生會話並選擇支援執行期上下文的預設。房間中的發言、投遞和驗收計數另外保存，供回顧協作過程使用。

目前的自動整理是**保留原文與來源的去重**；「遺忘」是可逆的召回衰減或抑制，原始日誌仍保留。尚未提供模型語義歸納、自動人格演化，也未證明真實模型能長期維持穩定人格。詳見[記憶生命週期](docs/memory-lifecycle.md)。

dsh-chat-local README · 使用前需要知道：- **權限會影響真實 Session。** 工作區寫入、完全權限等設定在離開群聊後仍可能生效。共用工作目錄也代表操作同一份檔案。詳見[權限與共享會話](docs/guide.md#權限與共享會話)。
- **資料保存在本機。** 預設目錄為 `~/.dsh/dsh-chat-local/`；目前狀態格式是 v18。回退至不相容的舊版時，需同時還原該版資料。
- **記憶有可見性與容量邊界。** 未收到的材料、掛載前的原生歷史和非文字內容，不會自動變成記憶。容量不足時拒絕新寫入，沒有無限歷史保證。
- **本機管理介面不做呼叫者認證。** Agent 工具的私人記憶隔離不等於對有本機檔案或管理 API 存取權的程式保密；日誌與人格檔未加密。
- **可追溯不代表內容正確。** 日誌能核對來源與修改痕跡，模型仍可能推理錯誤。測試通過或短期回覆一致，都不足以證明已完整模擬一個人。

dsh-chat-local README · dsh-chat-local：[中文](README.md) · **English**

Multi-agent collaboration in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), with persistent identities, user-defined personas, and memories grounded in each agent's own experience.

dsh-chat-local README · dsh-chat-local：Build a team, start separate conversations for different topics, and let members hand off work, submit results, and request review. An agent can recall material it has actually seen across conversations and execution sessions. Other members' private experiences do not automatically become shared memory.

dsh-chat-local README · Features：| Feature | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Teams and conversations | Reuse members and default settings while keeping each conversation's messages, work ledger, and permissions separate. |
| Agent interaction | New conversations route requests by responsibility. Notifications do not wake everyone; corrections and objections retain an explicit disposition. Existing conversations retain their previous strategy. |
| Work and artifacts | Pin responsibility, inputs, and acceptance criteria to a contract. Store retrievable immutable results and review the exact submitted versions. |
| Persona Markdown | Define each agent's personality, communication preferences, and working habits, with version history and conflict handling. |
| Personal long-term memory | Build memory from material actually delivered or read, and from the agent's own output, retaining references to its sources. |
| Memory and learning | Retrieve personally observed material for the current work. Sourced method candidates can be adopted, rejected, or retired; beliefs can carry counter-evidence. |
| Execution and permissions | Run members through real DSH sessions, using the host's models,
dsh-chat-local README · Getting started：The interface currently uses Chinese labels. The steps below retain those labels so you can find the corresponding controls.

dsh-chat-local README · 1. Install：The verified DSH version is `0.1.7-rc.2`; the declared host range is `>=0.1.7-rc.2 <0.1.8-0`. Install [dsh-bridge](https://github.com/baixianger/dsh-bridge) first; it handles waking local sessions and delivering messages.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ALPSIYH/dsh-chat-local
```

dsh-chat-local README · 1. Install：Restart `dsh web` after installation, then select **群聊** (Group chat) in the sidebar. Before upgrading an existing installation, back up the complete data directory as described in [Operations](docs/operations.md).

dsh-chat-local README · 2. Configure agents：Open **群聊 → Agent** to create or edit members. Names, roles, and models belong to their work configuration. The **人格** (Persona) editor describes preferences that persist across tasks.

The initial persona is an **inactive template awaiting configuration**. For example:

```md

dsh-chat-local README · Working habits：Start with one testable approach, state the key assumptions, then implement it.
Revise conclusions when new evidence arrives and explain which premise changed.

dsh-chat-local README · Communication preferences：Lead with the conclusion. Distinguish confirmed facts, inferences, and open questions.
```

Saved settings apply to subsequent turns. Personas are not rewritten automatically and do not grant additional execution permissions.

dsh-chat-local README · 3. Create a group and start a conversation：Create a group, choose its members, and start a conversation for a topic. Use the team defaults or adjust the participants, working directory, and permissions for that conversation.
section: 3. Create a group and start a conversation

text: dsh-chat-local README · 3. Create a group and start a conversation：New conversations without a selected strategy default to work routing; reused group templates keep their saved strategy. Work routing sends ordinary requests to the responsible member, falling back to a coordinator before work is assigned. Choose a message purpose, recipient, and work item in the composer. Names mentioned in prose do not dispatch work. The overview separates pending requests, execution budgets, and acceptance. Existing conversations retain legacy routing until explicitly switched while idle. Saving member or team settings alone does not start a model call.

Persistent agent identity
├── Persona: user-maintained PERSONA.md
├── Experiences: material actually received, read, or authored

dsh-chat-local README · How memory follows an agent：Group deliveries receive a length-limited memory summary. Agents can use `chat_recall` to retrieve more. Automatic context in a native session also depends on its DSH preset: `minimal` suppresses runtime contexts, so persona and personal memory are not injected there. The participant panel shows the capability observed during the last prompt assembly; open the native session and choose a preset that enables runtime context if needed. Room-level counts of messages, deliveries, and reviews are maintained separately to help inspect collaboration.

dsh-chat-local README · How memory follows an agent：Automatic consolidation currently means **deduplication that preserves source text and provenance**. Forgetting affects retrieval through decay or reversible suppression; the original logs remain. Model-generated semantic consolidation and automatic personality evolution are not implemented, and stable personality in real models has not been demonstrated. See [Memory lifecycle](docs/memory-lifecycle.md).

dsh-chat-local README · Before you use it：- **Permissions affect real sessions.** Workspace-write and full-access settings may remain active after leaving group chat. Members sharing a working directory also operate on the same files. See [Permissions and shared sessions](docs/guide.md#權限與共享會話).
- **Data is stored locally.** The default directory is `~/.dsh/dsh-chat-local/`, and the current state format is v18. Rolling back to an incompatible older version also requires restoring data compatible with that version.
- **Memory has visibility and capacity limits.** Unreceived material, native history from before the plugin was mounted, and non-text content do not automatically become memories. Capacity limits can prevent new writes; unlimited history is not guaranteed.
- **The local management API does not authenticate callers.** Private-memory isolation in agent tools does not protect against programs with access to local files or the management API. Logs and persona files are not encrypted.

dsh-chat-local README · Development：```sh
npm ci
npm run check
```

Run `npm run build` after changing the shared text or work protocols. `check` validates generated content, syntax, and regression tests. To test native DSH integration, set `DSH_MODULES_DIR` to the `node_modules` directory inside the DSH installation. See the [Maintainer guide](CONTEXT.md) for details.

Use `scripts/verify-event-log.mjs` for offline log verification. Follow [Operations](docs/operations.md) and work on a data copy taken after writes have stopped.
